story.head: Marchand has three assists as the Panthers beat the Senators
paras: Aleksander Barkov was back in the lineup after missing 22 games. Eetu Luostarinen got the scoring started for the Panthers late in the first. It was a busy second period. Dylan Cozens and Philip Tomasino scored 41 seconds apart early in the period to turn a 1-0 deficit into a 2-1 lead. Niko Mikkola tied it 2-2 for Florida midway through the period. Anton Lundell put the Cats ahead for good late in the period, with Dmitry Kulikov picking up his 200th NHL assist on the goal. Sam Bennett extended the lead to 4-2 on the power play midway through the third, and that insurance goal turned out to be the winner. Barkov added an empty-net goal with just under four minutes left to make it 5-2. With the goalie pulled and just under a minute left, Michael Amadio cut Florida’s lead to 5-3. Brad Marchand finished with three assists.

Nothing much separated these two on the chances. This one could have gone either way. Jacob Markström made 25 saves for the Panthers, and Linus Ullmark stopped 27 of 31 at the other end. The loss ended Ullmark’s six-game winning streak.
The Panthers killed all five Senators power plays. The Panthers moved to 14-8-3, fifth in the Atlantic, while the Senators fell to 16-7-3, still first in the Atlantic.
